caption: One package per line, ideally pinned to an exact version.
Captures every installed package, at its exact installed version.

code:
python -m venv .venv
# activate it, then:
pip install -r requirements.txt
caption: One command recreates the exact same environment anywhere.

code:
requests==2.31.0     # exact — most reproducible
requests>=2.31.0     # this or newer — can drift
requests>=2.31,<3.0  # a range
caption: Prefer == for applications you deploy; ranges for published libraries.

subtitle: When two packages want incompatible versions of the same thing.
